corrections.text: The article's Overview quotes Mateusz Pusz as writing, verbatim, "Contracts remain in the C++26 draft after the WG 21 meeting in Búzios, Brazil on November 17, 2026." The cited train-it.eu post does not contain this as one sentence. It reads: "Contracts remain in the C++26 draft. On Tuesday, 17 November 2026, at the WG 21 meeting in Búzios, Brazil, a plenary poll to remove them didn't reach consensus." The quoted text in the article combines wording from these two separate sentences. The underlying fact is accurate and supported by the source: contracts did remain in the draft, and the Nov. 17, 2026 plenary poll to remove them did not reach consensus.
